blocks.alt: Surkh kinare wale nau diamond pictograms, saada kaale nishanat ke saath: explosive (phat-ta bomb), flammable (shola), oxidising (daire par shola), compressed gas (gas cylinder), corrosive (tubes se satah aur haath par tapakta mayi), toxic (khopri aur haddiyan), irritant ya harmful (exclamation mark), mahol ke liye nuqsandeh (sookha darakht aur machhli) aur health hazard (insaan jis ke seene par sitara-numa nishan).
blocks.caption: Figure 16.2: Chemical hazards ke pictograms (kitab ki Figure 16.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har pictogram ek laal kinare wala diamond hai jis ke andar ek nishan hai. Chemical ki botal ke label par yeh nishan dekh kar foran pata chal jata hai ke woh phat sakta hai (explosive), aag pakarta hai (flammable), jalata hai (corrosive), zehreela hai (toxic) waghera.
Lab mein kaam karne wala chemicals ko standard procedures ke mutabiq istemal kare, aur har chemical ke khaas khatre aur us ke mehfooz istemal ke liye zaroori ehtiyaat (precautions) ko samne rakhe.

blocks.caption: Amal mein chemical hazards
rows: Har chemical ke liye standard procedure par chalein
Shuru karne se pehle khatraat pehchanein
Kabhi koi compound ya gas chakhein ya soonghein nahi

blocks.prompt: Koi reagent pehli baar istemal karne se pehle student us ke khatre kahan se maloom kare?
blocks.explanation: Us chemical ke standard procedure se aur botal ke label par lage hazard pictograms (Figure 16.2) se; kaam shuru karne se pehle yeh khatre aur zaroori ehtiyaat jaan lein.

items: Chemical hazards: har chemical ko standard procedure se istemal karein, us ke khatre aur ehtiyaat jaan kar.
Label par hazard pictograms (Figure 16.2) khatre ki qism batate hain.
